# AI Daily Radar

> Reusable two-source AI intelligence workflow with explicit freshness and coverage auditing.

## Agent entrypoints
- Read: ./AGENTS.md
- Machine-readable task manifest: ./manifest.yaml
- Skill router: ./SKILL.md

## Tasks
- follow-builders-daily -> ./prompts/follow-builders-daily.zh-CN.md
- aihot-daily -> ./prompts/aihot-daily.zh-CN.md

## Execution order
1. Read AGENTS.md and manifest.yaml.
2. Select one task unless the user explicitly requests both.
3. Read the selected prompt in full.
4. Check ./docs/source-contracts.md and the current upstream contract.
5. Execute the task while preserving freshness, pagination, deduplication, and coverage rules.

## Important scope rule
AIHOT coverage grade A means the queried public pool/window was paginated to completion. It does not mean the entire AIHOT database or the whole web was captured.

## Upstreams
- Follow Builders: https://github.com/zarazhangrui/follow-builders
- AIHOT Agent contract: https://aihot.news/agent
- AIHOT OpenAPI v1: https://aihot.news/openapi-v1.json
